title: Warden deeps
description: This project add lot of things. Starting, from the new, brand dimension, the warden deeps. A new block, called sculk jerk, and 2 brand new mobs, one u'll need to summon it by 2 blocks up of sculk, and a pumpking, and the other one is the Deep Guard
body:
This project is for fun and entertainment purposes and to have a direct link to download this mod for my friends and comunity, and add lot of things. Starting, from the new, brand dimension, the warden deeps. A new block, called sculk jerk, and 2 brand new mobs, one u'll need to summon it by 2 blocks up of sculk, and a pumpking, and the other one is the Deep Guard, and u'll only find him in the Deep Sculk dimension.

To go to that dimension, u'll need a lighter, but not any common, ull craft it as the image attached![The crafting recipe of the lighter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6cdf288d66a9e17c29483af28d71f548e600c00.png)

And u'll acces to that dimension, that is almost the exact same as the overworld... but inverted! U'll find lakes and oceans of leaked sculk.

And also, a brand new armor, crafted with echo shards, as the normal armor!
![The recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40bc0cadf54f484c016e27c07664b429b46fe7c6.png)


And much much more! But u'll need to find out!
